description.value: The Keg is a well-established Canadian steakhouse and bar chain situated in Pinetree Village, at the corner of Anson Avenue and Pinetree Way, across from Coquitlam Centre. The full-service restaurant features a bar and lounge, a patio, and a menu centred on premium steaks and classic North American fare. Takeout and DoorDash delivery are available for cyclists who prefer a meal on the go.
